Examples

Each pair shows the same feature with an html tagged template and with JSX. These files are code snippets. Run npm run build:package before using the .js examples from this repository; TSX examples need a TypeScript-aware automatic JSX transform.

Feature HTML template JSX
Counter and computed values counter.js counter.tsx
Conditional rendering conditional.js conditional.tsx
Preserving a hidden branch preserve.js preserve.tsx
Stores store.js store.tsx
Keyed todo list todo-list.js todo-list.tsx
Refs refs.js refs.tsx
Lifecycle cleanup unmount.js unmount.tsx
Error boundary error-boundary.js error-boundary.tsx
Fragments fragments.js fragments.tsx
